article.headline: Alvaro Cardenas Torre scores 19 to help Boise State beat Wyoming 67-58
article.description: — Alvaro Cardenas Torre had 19 points to lead Boise State to a 67-58 victory over Wyoming on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Alvaro Cardenas Torre scores 19 to help Boise State beat Wyoming 67-58
article.story: LARAMIE, Wyo. -- — Alvaro Cardenas Torre had 19 points to lead Boise State to a 67-58 victory over Wyoming on Tuesday night. Cardenas Torre also had six assists for the Broncos (11-3, 3-0 Mountain West Conference). Tyson Degenhart added 16 points and nine rebounds. Andrew Meadow pitched in with 11 points and six rebounds. A.J. Wills led the Cowboys (8-6, 1-2) with 17 points. Obi Agbim added 14 points and two steals. Boise State entered halftime up 25-19. Degenhart paced the team in scoring in the first half with six points. Boise State used a 9-2 run in the second half to build an eight-point lead at 54-46 with 3:49 left in the half before finishing off the win. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
